title: Joe Glazer's role managing Armstrong and his money
summary: Armstrong trusted Glazer like a father; Glazer invested his money and managed it after his death.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

Was that, is that kind of what, what, what Joe was? Yeah.
